text:
nora: Quick pilot idea — "Desk plant + $25 micro-stipend" drop for ~40 folks next Wed to boost cross-team recognition. Need leads for: plant pickup, prepaid gift codes, nomination curation, and distribution (onsite + remote). Thoughts? :seedling: :package:

maya: I'm in for plant pickup and distribution in SF. Can take 15 plants. Low-light varieties ok? :thumbsup:

sam: Love it. I can handle prepaid gift codes. Need expense code & vendor limit. Finance ok with $1,000 budget? @nora @maya

liam: For remote folks — we could send an e-gift card + a small care note. How do we collect addresses? We should avoid asking home addresses publicly.

recognize-bot: Reminder: nomination window per person is max 2 nominations per cycle. Link to form: https://go.redwood/nominate (auto caps at 2).

nora: Budget confirmed: use GL-POPS-RECOG. Sam, assign to that and ping finance for PO by EOD. Maya — please confirm pickup time Thursday afternoon. Liam — can you own the remote shipment list and card printing?

maya: Picking up at UrbanRoots on Thu 3pm. Will create a Google sheet for onsite roster and drop zones.

sam: Got it. Generating 40 x $25 codes now. I'll upload codes to the shared drive and remove after printing. Will also attach sample message for the gift email.

liam: I'll collect remote addresses via a one-question form and pass to shipping-bot. I'll also draft a 2-line note template.

shipping-bot: Shipping queue created: 40 items -> priority: onsite distribution + remote batch. ETA label print batch Tue 10am.

nora: Timeline: nomination window closes Fri 11:59pm, curation Sat, finalize recipients Sun, pack & send Mon/Tue. @everyone please add blockers ASAP. :sparkles:

maya: Spreadsheet here: https://go.redwood/sheets/plant-pilot (I'll update after pickup).

sam: FYI sample note:
"Thanks for being stellar — enjoy this little green and a small token of appreciation from Redwood. — People Ops"

liam: One more ask — can we include a tiny care card with watering tips? keep it one-liner.

nora: Yes. Maya — can you include the tips card in each package? I'll handle printing & stickers.

recognize-bot: Nomination summary will post in #people-ops on Mon AM.
